name: Animated Blood worms stay summoned but untouchable by NPCs while the owner rides (#12761)
contract: Animated Blood 573299 summons two Blood Worms 325301 as guardians with the owner's faction, so a hostile NPC
near a mounted Bloodmage attacks the worms and their combat pulls the owner in (#12761). Necromancer minions
solve the same report (#7457) by keeping the minions summoned and immune to NPCs while the owner is mounted
or in flight. Expected: before mounting a hostile NPC can attack a worm; while mounted it cannot, both worms
stay summoned, no worm engages the NPC and the owner stays out of combat; after dismounting the worm is
attackable again. The unmounted baseline reads 1, so the mounted 0 distinguishes the fix.

steps.label: Baseline: a hostile NPC can attack the unmounted owner's worm
DISCRIMINATING: mounted, the hostile NPC can no longer attack the worm
Mounted: no worm has engaged the NPC
Mounted: the owner has not been pulled into combat
Dismounted: the worm is attackable again
